corpus.selectionPolicy: Freeze exactly 20 distinct public upstream project identities selected for producer, runtime, language, dependency, hardening, and ELF-feature diversity. Every PR runs all 20; variants never add count. Binary fingerprints are CI-generated and compared against only the locked identity/class/data/machine/type/interpreter invariants.

provenance.redistribution: Public archive/package redistribution follows the declared upstream license; raw inputs stay in runner temporary storage and are never uploaded.

selection.rationale: Selected for shell-runtime, gnu.relro, gnu.stack coverage; this is a distinct public upstream identity and does not multiply libc/build variants.
distinctFrom: Distinct upstream project identity; variants are attributes and never increase the 20-project count.

static.reason: Every one of the locked 20 receives static ELF and UrProtect evidence before any dynamic oracle.

baseline.reason: The registry artifact is a single package/rootfs file without its complete dependency closure; no ambient host execution is inferred.

outerWrapper.reason: An outer comparison requires an explicit profile-matched launcher and is enabled only by a reviewed policy variant.

hostContext.reason: Ordinary public programs do not declare the urp_entry HostContext ABI.

expansion.shortfallEvidence: The approved slice remains 20 identities because only those records have complete cross-runtime policy and CI gate coverage. The exact-hash candidate ledger contains additional Debian ARM64 candidates, but native fingerprint/oracle evidence and runtime diversity are not yet sustained for a 100-identity promotion.
expansion.nextWave: Promote only reviewed increments after native AArch64 CI retains static fingerprints, first-failure results, and at least one non-glibc/runtime-diverse witness per increment.
